fusions.name: Lancet Draw
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: a cut that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Spent Venom
fusions.desc: Throws a knife that deals 12 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bled Clean
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Counteragent
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
